cohort: The study utilized fetal rats with myelomeningocele (MMC) induced in pregnant Sprague-Dawley rats and compared them to normal control fetal rats and a folic acid rescue group.
finding: Folic acid therapy significantly improved bladder functional deficiencies by increasing bladder nerve and smooth muscle-related protein synthesis and exhibiting anti-apoptotic properties in fetal rats with myelomeningocele (MMC).
